                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Intuitive email interface that keeps you organized and productive. Manage your inbox seamlessly while connecting to collaboration tools across your organization. Share files, schedule meetings, or jump into real-time chat — everything unified in one place.</span></p>
</div>

                                                                            	                                                                            	<div class="icon"><img src="https://www.zimbra.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/briefcase.png" alt="" width="48" /></div>
                                                                                																				<div><h4>Briefcase: File Management Simplified</h4></div>
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Store, manage, and share files securely with Briefcase without relying on third-party storage providers. Your documents stay accessible exactly where you need them.</span></p>
<p><b>Key capabilities:</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Centralized Storage</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> — Server-side file storage that keeps documents secure and accessible organization-wide</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Granular Access Controls</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> — Share files confidently with permission settings that determine who can view, edit, or download</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Version Tracking</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> — Maintain document history and roll back changes when needed</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Organized File Management</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> — Create folders, tag documents, and structure your file library for easy retrieval</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Seamless Integration</b><span style="font-weight: 400;"> — Access and share files directly from email, chat, or calendar without switching platforms</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Whether you’re collaborating with teams, or archiving for compliance, your documents remain accessible exactly where you need them.</span></p>
</div>

                                                                                																				<div><h4>Chat</h4></div>
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Keep your team in sync with enterprise-grade messaging. Collaborate instantly, share files, organize groups, search message history, and find channels — all within your secure communication environment. </span></p>
<p><b>Basic Chat</b><b><br />
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Perfect for one-on-one conversations, Basic Chat integrates seamlessly into your workflow for quick and efficient personal communication.</span></p>
<p><b>Advanced Chat</b><b><br />
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Elevate team collaboration with enterprise-grade messaging that includes:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">File sharing</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Group chats</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Message history search</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Channels</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Whether you’re handling daily communication or coordinating complex projects, Zimbra Chat scales to your needs. For more details, refer to the </span><a href="https://zimbra.github.io/documentation/zimbra-10/user-guide.html#_zimbra_chat" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Zimbra Chat User Guide</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://zimbra.github.io/documentation/zimbra-10/adminguide.html#zimbra_chat" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Administrator Guide</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">. Download the </span><a href="https://www.zimbra.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Zimbra-Chat-Basic-vs-Advanced-Datasheet.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Zimbra Chat Datasheet</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to explore the full capabilities.</span></p>
</div>

                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Coordinate effortlessly with shared calendars designed for teams and enterprises. Schedule meetings, set reminders, and manage resources — all while maintaining visibility across departments and time zones. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">With full mobile access via native apps and ActiveSync, you can view calendars, respond to invites, and stay in control anytime, anywhere, on any device.</span></p>

                                                                                																				<div><h4>Office: Create, Edit, and Collaborate</h4></div>
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work smarter with integrated tools for document creation and real-time collaboration — no third-party subscriptions required.</span></p>
<p><b>Key capabilities:</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Real-time secure collaboration </span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">In-browser editing for documents, spreadsheets, and slides</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Full support for open-office formats ensures consistent formatting across tools</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Universal File Compatibility: Support for popular file types including docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, ods, odp, pdf, txt, rtf, html, epub, csv, and more</span></li>
</ul>

                                                                                																				<div><h4>Anywhere, Anytime Access: <br />Web • Mobile (ActiveSync) • Desktop (Offline) </h4></div>
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Zimbra’s clean, consistent interface ensures seamless collaboration whether you’re at your desk, on the go, or working offline. Connect using your preferred platform without sacrificing functionality or security.</span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Exchange ActiveSync (EAS): Mobile Integration</b></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sync email, calendars, contacts, tasks, and shared folders across all EAS-compatible devices in real time. No additional clients required—stay connected on iOS, Android, and beyond.</span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Zimbra Connector for Outlook (ZCO)</b></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Integrate seamlessly with Outlook for Windows, Mac, and Web. Access synchronized emails, calendar overlays, global address lists, and modern OAuth2 authentication—directly within your existing Outlook environment.</span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Exchange Web Services (EWS)</b></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Deep integration with any EWS-compatible client for advanced capabilities including real-time calendar lookups, delegation, resource booking, and server-side search. No add-ons required.</span></p>
<ul>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Desktop (Offline)</b></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Stay productive offline. Zimbra Desktop syncs your emails, calendars, contacts, and tasks so you can work anywhere and reconnect seamlessly when back online.</span></p>
<p><b>For the full list of supported platforms and clients, see the </b><a href="https://zimbra.github.io/documentation/zimbra-10/adminguide.html#_client_compatibility_overview" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>Admin Guide: Client Compatibility Overview</b></a><b>.</b></p>

                                                                                																				<div><h4>Security and Compliance</h4></div>
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><p>Zimbra delivers robust capabilities designed for data sovereignty, streamlined administration, and regulatory compliance.</p>
<p><b>Security and Compliance</b></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Mobile Device Management (ABQ)</b><b><br />
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Allow/Block/Quarantine capabilities automatically restrict unauthorized devices without disrupting legitimate productivity.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)<br />
</b>Add an extra layer of protection with two-factor authentication for secure user logins across your organization.</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>S/MIME Encryption<br />
</b>Enable email signing and encryption to ensure message authenticity and confidentiality for sensitive communications.</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Single Sign-On (SSO)<br />
</b>Zimbra functions as a SAML Service Provider, integrating seamlessly with identity providers like Keycloak, Cisco Duo, and JumpCloud. Users access Zimbra through your unified corporate login portal, optionally incorporating MFA via your SAML provider.</li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Compliance Archiving<br />
</b>Archive emails with tamper-evident controls and full auditing capabilities to meet stringent regulatory standards and legal discovery requirements.</li>
</ul>
</div>

                                                                                																				<div><h4>Administrative Control</h4></div>
                                                                            </div>
                                                                            <div class="tabcontent">
																				<div class="t_content"><ul>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Multi-Tenancy</b><b><br />
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Manage multiple organizations or departments on a single instance with distinct policies and settings for each tenant—ideal for organizations or enterprises with diverse business units.</span></li>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Delegated Administration<br />
</b>Assign granular admin roles by group or function, enabling distributed management while maintaining centralized oversight and control.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<li aria-level="1"><b>Hierarchical Storage Management (HSM)</b><b><br />
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Configure internal and external storage volumes—including S3-compatible object stores—directly from the Admin Console. Set policies to offload older emails, attachments, or archives to secondary storage for cost efficiency. HSM capabilities include compression, deduplication, and rule-based data movement for optimized long-term retention.</span></li>
<li aria-level="1"><b>Backup & Restore</b><b><br />
</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">Zimbra’s backup system ensures reliable data protection without service interruption. Choose auto-grouped backups for faster, incremental operations or standard full backups for comprehensive coverage—both options deliver flexibility for any deployment environment.</span></li>
</ul>

                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>What is Zimbra?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p>For more than 20 years, Zimbra has been a scalable email and collaboration platform trusted by over 200 million users worldwide.                                                                                                         <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3> Which platforms and devices are compatible with Zimbra?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Web Access</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">: All modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari) across Windows, macOS, and Linux.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Desktop Clients</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Zimbra Desktop, Microsoft Outlook (via Zimbra Connector), Mozilla Thunderbird.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Mobile Devices</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Native support for iOS and Android via ActiveSync, and third-party apps.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><b>For the full list of supported platforms and clients, see the </b><a href="https://zimbra.github.io/documentation/zimbra-10/adminguide.html#_client_compatibility_overview" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>Admin Guide: Client Compatibility Overview</b></a><b>.</b></p>

                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>Do I need a commercial license?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p>Zimbra’s core server is open-source, with advanced features such as high-availability clustering, encryption, and large-scale sync available through a commercial license. For more information around our plans, view <a href="https://www.zimbra.com/product/enterprise-collaboration/#edition-comparison" target="_blank" rel="noopener">here</a>.</p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>How does Zimbra ensure secure email communication?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>S/MIME Encryption & Digital Signing</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Full end-to-end encryption for email security.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>TLS Encryption</b><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Secures all communications between Zimbra clients and servers.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><b>Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)</b>: Adds an extra layer of security for user logins.</li>
</ul>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>Is Zimbra GDPR and HIPAA compliant?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p>Zimbra is capable of supporting both GDPR and HIPAA compliance, but actual compliance depends on how the platform is configured and maintained within an organization.</p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>How does Zimbra handle Backup & Restore?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p>Zimbra’s in-built Backup & Restore system ensures that data can be backed up without downtime. Administrators can choose from multiple backup modes to suit your organizational needs and requirements.</p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>How do I get started on Zimbra?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><a href="https://www.zimbra.com/connect/forms/?form=web-client" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>Web Client</b></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Accessible on all modern browsers.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><a href="https://www.zimbra.com/connect/forms/?form=trial-license" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>Zimbra Desktop</b></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Full offline access for email, calendar, and contacts.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ready to move forward? Request your custom quote today.</span></p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>Is Zimbra mobile-friendly?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Absolutely. Zimbra offers:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Push-sync for email, calendar, and contacts via ActiveSync on iOS and Android.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Responsive Web Client for mobile devices.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support for IMAP/SMTP, CalDAV, and CardDAV for third-party apps.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>Does Zimbra have integrated messaging?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Yes, Zimbra Chat feature provides:</span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Real-time team communication, direct messages, and group chats.</span></li>
<li style="font-weight: 400;" aria-level="1"><span style="font-weight: 400;">File sharing and collaborative tools for a unified experience.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-weight: 400;">For more information, view our </span><a href="https://www.zimbra.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Zimbra-Chat-Basic-vs-Advanced-Datasheet.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Zimbra Chat Datasheet</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>How scalable is Zimbra?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p>Zimbra grows with your organization — from small teams to enterprise deployments supporting millions of users.</p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>How can I renew support?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p><a href="https://www.zimbra.com/connect/support/support-offerings/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Renewing support</a> ensures access to the latest security patches, feature updates, and continued system reliability. Contact your Account Manager or email renewals@zimbra.com.</p>
</div>
                                                        <div class="clearer"></div>
                                                    </div>
                                                                                                        <div class="tabbox">
                                                        <div class="tabtitle"><h3>How do I get support?</h3></div>
                                                        <div class="tabcontent"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Submit tickets through our </span><a href="https://support.zimbra.com/s/login/?ec=302&startURL=%2Fs%2F" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support Portal</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, which includes ticket tracking and a comprehensive knowledge base.</span></p>
</div>
